# Schema Requirements Checklist: Align Business Schema

**Purpose**: Review whether the schema requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and ready for planning
**Created**: 2026-11-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command from the feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the requirements have been reviewed and satisfy the criterion; it does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are required attributes, relationships, optionality, and uniqueness defined for each of the 25 database business entities and the two product-wide administration entities? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are the exact allowed values defined for every controlled role code, activity state, registration state, attendance state, and appeal type and state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are the required values and boundaries defined for signed activity points, awarded points, criterion maxima, and score changes? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK004 Are the permitted combinations of source, semester, criterion, and student specified for both participation and recognition scores? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK005 Are the required fields, content types, size limits, and access rules for appeal evidence all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK006 Are the minimum audit details and the events that require audit records specified for settings, score changes, and appeal decisions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is “every required relationship” enumerated precisely enough to distinguish mandatory from optional references? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK008 Is “one score per source and criterion” clear for both participation and recognition sources, including null-source cases? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Are the meanings of “verified participation,” “approved recognition,” and “student-owned record” defined sufficiently to determine valid score and appeal references? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK010 Are “published readiness,” “waiting-list promotion,” and “historical criteria” broken into objective conditions rather than left as broad references? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK011 Is the intended scope of “auditable” clear about actor, timestamp, before and after values, immutability, and failed attempts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 Are the feature’s entity names and status values consistent with the database business requirements and the product vision where the two sources differ? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK013 Is the rule for a correction appeal with a missing registration consistent with the type-specific reference rule and the edge-case statement? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Are one-role accounts and cumulative staff permissions consistent with the access and ownership requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Are historical criterion immutability and score-change history requirements consistent with later policy changes and adjusted awards? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-010]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Does each functional requirement have at least one acceptance scenario or measurable outcome that can distinguish compliance from noncompliance? [Measurability, Spec §Functional Requirements, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [x] CHK017 Does SC-001 define what counts as a valid example record for each entity, including records with optional references? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK018 Does SC-002 identify the authoritative set of explicit invalid cases and a clear passing threshold? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK019 Does SC-003 specify who reviews the sample records and what counts as identifying a rejection reason correctly? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK020 Are the registration and activity-creation time targets relevant to this schema alignment and consistent with the product vision? [Consistency, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are primary activity-to-score, recognition, and correction flows each covered by requirements and acceptance scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–2]
- [x] CHK022 Are alternate cases defined for outside activities, prior-semester recognition, multi-session attendance, and users with staff and student duties? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Are rejection and recovery requirements defined for duplicate applications, mismatched activity references, incomplete decisions, and partial score changes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005–FR-008]
- [x] CHK024 Are concurrent capacity decisions and first-come-first-served waitlist promotion specified with measurable ordering and no-oversubscription conditions? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK025 Are migration failure, existing invalid records, and rollback expectations defined for a populated installation? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Non-Functional Requirements and Dependencies

- [x] CHK026 Are authorization, privacy, and audit requirements tied to each sensitive record type and role? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK027 Are evidence retention, file access, and notification delivery requirements aligned with the product vision? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011–FR-012]
- [x] CHK028 Is the dependency on verified university identity and faculty data documented with a clear fallback when verification is unavailable? [Dependency, Gap]
- [x] CHK029 Is the choice of the database business requirements as the detailed authority validated for cases where the product vision describes a different status or entity? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK030 Are the boundaries between record-level constraints and transaction-level business rules identified for every requirement that spans multiple records? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-010]

## Notes

- Items were evaluated against the revised feature specification and source requirements under the user’s explicit instruction to resolve every item and proceed. This is requirements-quality review, not implementation completion.

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add reviewer findings inline and link to supporting requirements or decisions.
